decisions.reason: As a distributed perfect binder close to the core finishing portfolio, it costs the wholesaler little to keep listed, and there is no evidence that its value has failed to materialize, so the option is worth retaining.
The fully automatic binder fits the firm's stated push into integrated automation, so it keeps strategic option value at low carrying cost.
The inline/nearline booklet maker supports the firm's digital print finishing direction and adds little cost to its trading portfolio, so keeping it is justified while demand develops.
